title: Sustainability
description: How Gemcon City Limited designs for daylight, ventilation, green cover and lower running costs in every project.

data.title: Building lightly on the city
data.intro: Daylight, cross-ventilation and green cover cost less to include at the start than to retrofit later.

data.body:
A building uses resources for decades after it is finished. We make the choices that reduce that use during design, when they are cheapest, and publish them on each project page.

Our approach

Every project is reviewed against a short checklist covering orientation, shading, ventilation, water and waste. Where a project falls short, the review explains why and what was done instead.

items.title: Daylight and air
items.text: Living rooms face the open side of the plot and every unit is tested for cross-ventilation.

items.title: Green cover
items.text: Trees, planters and rooftop gardens are part of the approved design, not an afterthought.

items.title: Lower running costs
items.text: Efficient lighting, water recycling for gardens and shaded façades reduce bills for owners.

data.heading: Measured on site, not only on paper
data.body: Our engineers record water and energy use in the first year of occupancy for selected projects, and the results feed back into the next design.

data.heading: Visit a project and see the details.
data.text: Book a site visit and ask our engineers how each building is designed.
